title: Prove exact conjugation tariffs for separate complex frames (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove an exact tariff for a concrete real-linear escape from complex-linear frame changes. For real orthogonal P,Q, the map T(x+iy)=Px+iQy needs exactly rank(P-Q) single-coordinate conjugations when arbitrary invertible complex-linear frames are free. Any finite number of exactly restored dirty complex coordinates leaves the minimum unchanged. Rational P,Q have an attaining rational compiler with no square roots.

```text
separate orthogonal frames P,Q
  -> r = rank(P-Q)
  -> r imaginary Householder reflections
  -> r coordinate conjugations, with explicit rational basis instructions
  -> complete endpoint T direct-sum identity on dirty coordinates
```

Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Antilinear-part rank subadditivity and Cartan-Dieudonne-Scherk factorization are classical and credited in PROOF.md, including [constructive reflection-factorization background](https://arxiv.org/abs/1011.1027). No literature-priority claim is made for those ingredients.

The model changes the free operations and the field of linearity: these are actual real-linear endpoints and complex-linear frames, rather than formal group-algebra register words. The original question is recorded in the [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19376836). Only `research/real-imaginary-conjugation-tariff/` is added. The selected frontier is unchanged.

## Evidence

Before, a proposal to change real and imaginary frames had no explicit tariff in this declared interface. After, an antilinear-rank lower bound matches the rational compiler for every real orthogonal pair. For P=I and Q=[[3/5,-4/5],[4/5,3/5]], the exact count is two, excluding one call even with arbitrary restored dirty workspace.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS 27.0.1 arm64, standard library only:

- 2,921 complete program fixtures cover 124,532 real endpoint entries and 22,136 emitted instructions. They include every ordered signed-permutation pair through dimension three, every dimension-four target with P=I, parameterized oblique rational/dirty fixtures, and dimension/coefficient boundaries.
- A separate 64-entry fixture transiently mixes active and dirty data through a nonreal complex-linear shear and restores the dirty endpoint.
- All 781 words of length zero through four over five generators agree with an independent 2-by-2 Gaussian determinant oracle.
- Nine invalid/unsupported inputs and three actual endpoint corruptions reject. All checks remain active under optimization.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass in 4.47 and 4.83 seconds respectively, with identical complete generated hash-bound receipts. The registered replay passes both commands. These are replay durations, not performance comparisons.
- Metadata/pins, AST/function-size/tabnanny checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight, official seven-file export integrity and a read-only Git-free optimized export replay with empty PATH pass. The portable receipt equals the complete working receipt.

From the worktree root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/real-imaginary-conjugation-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/real-imaginary-conjugation-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/real-imaginary-conjugation-tariff
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/real-imaginary-conjugation-tariff --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 interpreter may replace the local absolute path. Expected scientific marker: `PASS_REAL_IMAGINARY_CONJUGATION_TARIFF`. The finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not supply its all-size quantifier.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The free frames are an optimistic accounting hypothesis. Their physical cost is unknown here. The rational constructor may use odd denominators, so it is not automatically a legal dyadic basis compiler. The executable compiler admits dimension at most eight, input entries at most 256 bits and guarded matrix-product entries at most 4,096 bits. Exceeding an executable guard is not a mathematical obstruction.

No actual P104 cut, productive target, native conjugation, coefficient delivery, physical basis/scalar bill, owned-storage schedule, precision/tape/stock proof, all-size supplier compiler or complete outer invoice is supplied. Arbitrary real-linear targets outside separate orthogonal P,Q are not classified. No predecessor result was audited or replayed. Selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, a rounded multiplier, independent human review and formal proof-kernel review were not run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No new kappa is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Bind one actual producer/consumer using separate real and imaginary frames, and price every basis, conjugation, return and target change. Native delivery and a favorable complete signed invoice are missing.
2. Fix a physical coefficient ring and determine whether one reached rational P,Q pair admits an attaining program in that ring. Odd denominators in the displayed frames are an explicit blocker.

## Related open work

- [#6613](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6613) proves a formal monomial-group reflection tariff with scalar mixing. This uses actual real-linear maps, grants complex-linear frames and charges coordinate conjugation; ordinary displacement rank would give the wrong tariff here.
- [#6403](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6403) prices normal targets in finite binary semilinear groups. This studies real orthogonal frame pairs over complex coordinates, with a different free-operation contract and no common numerical optimum.

Final refresh of this account's open PRs created since the CLAIM found no additional PR studying this exact coordinate-conjugation interface or computing the same tariff. The related open work above remains current. No newly inspected result supplies a conflicting common number.

Fresh object/general-form searches found no open PR on this exact coordinate-conjugation interface. Live claims and reservations were checked before commitment; canonical main remained `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, selected PR6030. Sparse notes, unpublished work and arbitrary historical diffs remain overlap limits.
